text:
Hi team,

Just a quick note from the Companion Animal Travel Desk as we settle into the usual flow of bookings, handoffs, and post-flight follow-up. Thanks for keeping the animal welfare checks steady and for making sure every file reflects the comfort needs we have on hand before the journey starts. The care we provide works best when the desk, the welfare coordinator, and the ground team stay closely aligned, so please keep flagging anything unusual early and clearly.

On the desk side, I am seeing the usual mix of intake updates, carrier checks, and pickup confirmations, and it is helping a lot when notes are kept complete and easy to follow. A few recent cases have reminded me how important it is to treat each journey as a shared responsibility from booking through pickup, especially when an animal needs a little extra attention during transfer between services. Please continue to document any handling concerns, bedding requests, feeding notes, or comfort changes as soon as they come in, so the next person in the chain can keep things smooth without guesswork.

If you are working with travelers and pet owners directly, a calm and friendly tone goes a long way, and it helps reinforce the trust people place in Aurelia Skyways. I appreciate the care everyone is bringing to the routine work, and I know the consistency at this desk makes a real difference for the animals and for the travelers who are counting on us.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
